sourceSet.name: IPEX System XFR catalogue import
notes: Rows are derived from official IPEX current May 4 2026 System XFR XLS price lists, not generated from guessed fitting families.
Fitting rows come from official IPEX rows whose Prod-Desc contains PVC DWV and SYSTEM XFR; cement/primer rows are excluded.
Descriptions are the clean part label without material or size. H x H / SP x H style connection text is retained because those are distinct IPEX part variants.
TY is the primary display label for sanitary tee style fittings. San Tee and Sanitary Tee wording remains in aliases.
Bushings only appear when the official IPEX row has two sizes. One-size generated bushings were removed.
Supplier costs/preferred supplier links remain blank unless a supplier source confirms them. IPEX P-Code/UPC/list price are kept as manufacturer source evidence.
Degree-based fittings that had SP x H in the description now display as Fitting <angle>..., with SP x H moved to aliases.
Degree-based fittings that had SP x H-style connection text now display as Fitting <angle>..., with the full connection pattern moved to aliases and exact display duplicates merged.
Hub-only connection text such as H x H or H x H x H is implied for plumbers and is removed from display/description; hub wording stays in aliases.
SP is treated as spigot. Non-hub-only connection variants remain in aliases/display only where needed to distinguish nonstandard variants.
Pipe app-facing names/descriptions use 10 ft per Tim's field rule, while the official IPEX source description remains in source evidence/aliases.
Wye display/description omits 45 because 45 degrees is implied for wyes; 45 wording remains in aliases/source evidence.
Bushing display/description omits SP x H because spigot x hub is implied for those bushings; SP x H wording remains in aliases/source evidence.
Couplings with more than one size dimension display as Reducing Coupling; plain Coupling remains in aliases/source evidence.
Reducing Bushing displays as Bushing because reducing is implied for bushings; Reducing Bushing remains in aliases/source evidence.

Rows are ordered for field review by trade-friendly groups: Pipe, 90s, 45s, Coupling, Wye, TY, Cap, Cleanouts, Fitting 90, Fitting 45, P-traps, 60s, 22-1/2s, 11-1/4s, Toilet/Closet flanges, Trap adapters, Dishwasher fittings, Double Wye, Double TY, then remaining parts.
Double Wye rows are preserved as Double Wye from IPEX source descriptions and ordered in their own review section.
